annotations.title: Flash ELF on a real MCU

description: Flash a pre-built ELF you compiled locally (see AGENTS.md hello/). Pass the binary as elf_base64, or elf_url on https. Do not pass a filesystem path. Requires a Pay With Prompt voucher (merchant cloudhil, 10 credits = 1 flash). Cloudhil verifies it server-side before programming. Returns result.mailbox (NNOK 0x4E4E4F4B) and result.uart. nucleo-n6 and lpc55569-evk require .elf. Oneshot: runs at most 20 s on the board, then erase; answer in under a minute. Needs a Cloudhil account (Connect / OAuth).

elf_base64.description: Base64 of the ELF/BIN/HEX you compiled locally (max 2 MiB decoded)

elf_url.description: https URL of the ELF if it is too large for elf_base64

filename.description: Original filename ending in .elf .bin or .hex (default firmware.elf)

voucher.description: Pay With Prompt voucher pwpv_… for merchant cloudhil, from https://paywithprompt.com. Not logged.
